description: Run the Puppet agent once and return the exit status

waitforcert.description: Seconds to wait for a certificate to be signed (0 = submit CSR and exit immediately)

environment.description: Environment to run against, passed as --environment. Omitted, the agent uses the environment the server assigned on its last run, falling back to puppet.conf; with it, the agent asks for this one and the run fails if the server does not have it
